context_summary: The page presents a plan and section of a cistern at Khirbet el-Kikh.
The page shows a plan of the southeastern area of Tel Beit Mirsim, including cistern no. 15-A33.
The page displays a plan and section of the fortress at Khirbet Abu et-Twein, indicating the location of a cistern, and a separate plan and section of the cistern itself.
The page features a general view of the cistern at Khirbet Abu et-Twein and a photo of the cistern's opening and a corner of the fortress.
The page shows images of plaster on the wall of the cistern at Khirbet Abu et-Twein, including plaster composed of sand.
The page presents a plan of the Qumran site, highlighting a prominent round cistern and detailing components of its water system.
The page includes photographs of the round cistern at Qumran during conservation work and showing the opening of the original channel.
The page displays a plan of Tel Ira, indicating the locations of cisterns O-1 to O-6, and photos of the openings of cisterns O-1 and O-2.
The page provides a plan of the site of Uza, showing a drainage channel, a cistern, and two depressions, along with a plan of the middle cistern at its foot.
The page features photographs of the middle cistern at Uza, viewed from the north and the east.
The page includes a plan of Horvat Radum, marking various depressions within the site.
The page shows a schematic diagram of open cistern no. 305 located at Har Nafha.
The page presents a schematic diagram of open cistern no. 122 in the Nahal Boqer channel.
The page illustrates Metzudat Etzboa, noting the presence of two open cisterns within it.
